name: brain-autopilot-core-v3.1
description: v3.1 Benchmark suite covering Live CDP Web, Shadow DOM & Playwright-style ARIA Refs, JS Dialog & Occlusion Guards, Responsive Viewport Emulation & Network Idle, Loop-Aware Decision Policy, Real PNG Frame Persistence & HTML Fidelity, Bug/A11y/Perf Detectors, Warm CDP Reuse, Mobile XML, 3D Canvas, Blind Vision, Zero-LLM Regression Replay, and Doctor Diagnostics.

tasks.description: Multi-step SPA cart + email fill + idempotent checkout + deterministic regression replay
Catch console_error, 404 network_error, horizontal_overflow, <44px touch_target, broken_image, and test mute rules
Catch WCAG missing alt, unlabeled interactive controls, DOM/LCP telemetry, and mute rules
Verify warm shared CDPSession.reset_page() clears error/storage state cleanly between runs
Pierce open Shadow DOM Web Components, resolve Playwright-style ARIA refs (e1..eN), and verify zero false-positive unlabeled alerts on <label for>
Reject clicks on overlay-occluded controls via elementFromPoint and auto-handle blocking JS alert dialogs without CDP deadlock
Detect mobile-only horizontal overflow via Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride and await in-flight XHR/fetch completion in wait_settled()
Parse Android uiautomator XML and flag <44px touch target accessibility violations
Verify painted vs blank canvas detection over live CDP or telemetry hook
Verify blind vision leading-question guard and Redactor credential/path scrubbing
Verify doctor IDE/typing diagnostics and zero-dependency self-contained HTML report generation
Verify loop-aware decision policy escapes no-op decoys, persists episode PNG frames, and renders real kind='decision' traces in report.html
